hooks.prompt: Before stopping: (a) state which task type the work was (generate-schema / update-generator / add-component / update-code / investigate, per CLAUDE.md). (b) For generate-schema, update-generator, add-component, or update-code: confirm each required gate ran successfully end-to-end (check the gate matrix in CLAUDE.md). For investigate: confirm no source files were modified. (c) Confirm nothing in the original request is still outstanding. If any of these is not satisfied, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}.
